text:
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks everyone for the questions during today's all-hands. Opening a thread to capture follow-ups on reviews, promotions, comp moves, and next steps.

Sam (Eng Manager): Quick one  when is the final calibration packet due?

Aisha (People Ops): Final packet due 2025-04-04 EOD PT. Use the shared spreadsheet and upload signed manager summaries to the HR portal by then.

Jordan (IC): If someone gets a leveling change, is the band effective retroactively to the review period start or from publish?

Dana (HR): New level takes effect on publish date. Retroactive pay can be requested but needs a business case + Finance sign-off.

Leo (Finance): Note: retroactive adjustments >$5k require VP Finance approval and will be processed in the next payroll run.

Sam (Eng Manager): Any recommended format for manager comments so calibration is consistent?

Aisha (People Ops): Use this short format for manager summaries: 1) Context (scope + impact), 2) Evidence (3 examples), 3) Recommendation (level, band, target comp). Keep under 400 words.

hr-bot: :calendar: Calibration meeting scheduled 2025-04-10 09:00-12:00 PT. Prep docs attached to the event.

Jordan (IC): Are we adjusting comp bands this cycle? Midpoint vs range changes?

Dana (HR): Expect mostly midpoint adjustments (~3%) for market movement; some scarce-role bands may widen. Final band changes announced day before publish.

Sam (Eng Manager): What about promotion cadence for borderline cases (L4 -> L5)?

Aisha (People Ops): Cadence unchanged. Nominate when readiness criteria met. For borderline, include development plan + recommended effective date in the packet.

Jordan (IC): If someone wants to appeal, what's the timeline?

Dana (HR): Appeals accepted within 14 days of publish via HR form. We triage within 7 business days and reply with next steps.

Sam (Eng Manager): Can we get a manager checklist?

Aisha (People Ops): Manager checklist (copy/paste): - Complete ratings + comments by 2025-04-01 (manager draft) - Upload signed summary PDF to HR portal by 2025-04-04 - Confirm calibration attendees/proxies by 2025-04-07 - Review comp guidance doc (emailed 2025-04-03) - Attach promotion rubric + 3 impact examples for nominees - Flag retroactive pay requests by 2025-04-02

Leo (Finance): Also confirm any off-cycle hires/adjustments that affect comp budget.

Sam (Eng Manager): Can we get a manager summary template?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes, we'll post the template in #people-ops-resources and email to managers by EOD today.

Jordan (IC): Will managers see calibration notes after the meeting?

Dana (HR): Managers will receive calibration outcomes and anonymized notes. Individual reviewer comments are not shared.

Aisha (People Ops): If managers want 1:1 prep, book People Ops office hours (link in calendar). Tag me for urgent cases. :thumbsup:
